scope: Define the selected ARCALIGNEDTEXT D2T conversion behavior for binary64 subnormals and decimal values that underflow to zero, separately for typed DXF input and strict output of retained D2T strings.

policyBasis.projectTypedInputBehavior: The existing typed DXF numeric reader accepts the smallest nonzero binary64 subnormal and accepts 1e-9999 as finite zero; these expectations are asserted by testTypedInput in tests/numeric_locale_tests.cpp.
policyBasis.implementationDecision: Preserve every finite nonzero binary64 D2T value. A retained D2T string that converts with ERANGE to zero is refused by strict output because it represents a nonzero decimal value that binary64 cannot carry. This is a bounded local loss policy, not a normative ARCALIGNEDTEXT rendering rule.

changes: Added parseFinitePrefix: accepts finite nonzero subnormals even when strtod reports ERANGE, rejects overflow/non-finite values and rejects ERANGE results that are zero.
ARCALIGNEDTEXT approximation height parsing and strict DXF D2T output use the bounded range policy.
A generated group-42 subnormal control survives typed Binary-DXF parsing and applyArcApproximation with exact height.
A same-adapter ASCII output control refuses raw D2T 1e-9999, preserves a sentinel destination, then succeeds after correction to denorm_min; fresh ASCII readback returns the exact subnormal.
implementation.fixturePolicy: All test inputs and outputs are generated in memory or under the temporary test directory. No DWG/DXF fixture is added.
implementation.lexicalBoundary: Existing numeric-prefix compatibility is retained; this slice does not establish a full-token D2T lexical grammar.

claimBoundary: This is a locally selected conversion and loss policy for ARCALIGNEDTEXT D2T fields only.
Other numeric/string callers, D2T trailing-text grammar, external producers, full DWG conversion, native rendering, and platform behavior remain outside this evidence.
No DWG/DXF, FreeCAD, LibreCAD, LibreCAD_3, or general ARCALIGNEDTEXT support claim is promoted.
